## File: facebookresearch_mask2former/demo/demo.py

Prompts

```
['run mask2former panoptic segmentation on input images using the demo CLI with --input flag', 'run mask2former panoptic segmentation on a video file using the --video-input flag', 'run mask2former panoptic segmentation on live webcam feed using the --webcam flag', 'setup a detectron2 config object by merging a YAML config file with command-line options', 'test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the system', 'run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize panoptic, semantic, or instance segmentation on a single image', 'run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize segmentation results on each frame of a video', 'create an AsyncPredictor to run Detectron2 model predictions asynchronously across multiple GPUs', 'use AsyncPredictor put and get methods to enqueue images and retrieve predictions in order', 'review the AsyncPredictor shutdown method that sends stop tokens to all worker processes']
```

Usage

```
{'run_mask2former_on_images': 'run mask2former panoptic segmentation on input images using the demo CLI with --input flag', 'run_mask2former_on_video': 'run mask2former panoptic segmentation on a video file using the --video-input flag', 'run_mask2former_on_webcam': 'run mask2former panoptic segmentation on live webcam feed using the --webcam flag', 'setup_mask2former_config': 'setup a detectron2 config object by merging a YAML config file with command-line options', 'test_opencv_video_format': 'test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the system'}
```
